title: THE BLACK INK PROBLEM
intro: Reconstruct four redacted fields. For each answer, select the supporting attachment.

evidence.label: A / DISPATCH AMENDMENT
evidence.text: JM-041: harbour delivery CANCELLED. Replacement destination: airport depot B-6. This amendment supersedes the original route.

evidence.label: B / TRANSFER REGISTER
evidence.text: JM-041: asset transfer entered under S-2. Register key: S = sealed annex. No owner-return receipt is attached.

evidence.label: C / RADIO LOG
evidence.text: JM-041: contact lost during transport. No later check-in. No recovery confirmation. Status must remain CONTACT LOST pending verification.

evidence.label: D / CARBON IMPRESSION
evidence.text: JM-041: final approval reads C-17. The 1 is a straight stroke; the 7 has a crossbar. Impression matches the approved copy.

evidence.label: E / ORIGINAL ROUTE
evidence.text: JM-041: deliver to the harbour warehouse. Stamp: SUPERSEDED. Retained for the audit trail, not for dispatch.

evidence.label: F / REJECTED REQUEST
evidence.text: Request C-71. Stamp: REJECTED. The replacement approval is on the carbon copy. This sheet does not authorize the operation.

success: The destination was amended, the transfer used a sealed annex, and contact was lost. Approval C-17 is on the final copy. This does not establish whether John died.
lead: Ask Alex Murphy about the transport and its separately filed records.
